newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Resources up on spinoff hopes.
newsitem.headline: China Resources up on spinoff hopes.

text.p: Shares of China Resources Enterprise Ltd surged to hit an all time high of HK$9.00 Friday morning on hopes of stronger earnings following its planned spinoff of its China property unit, brokers said.
China Resources shares stood at HK$8.95 at midday, up HK$0.40 or 4.68 percent. Volume was 3.82 million shares.

"Anticipation a possible expectional gain from spinning off the unit fueled speculative demand," said a sales manager at a regional brokerage. The company said this week it expected to raise HK$550-HK$850 million through a separate listing of its China property unit. -- HK Newsroom (852) 2843 6370
